summarize_default_det_models: summarize the default_det_models dictionary containing detection model configs for human, face, hand, and animal
review_default_det_models: review the default_det_models dict to understand model, weights, and cat_ids for each detection target
create_custom_det_model_config: create a custom detection model config entry in default_det_models with model, weights, and cat_ids fields
build_detector_from_config: build a detector by importing default_det_models and passing its config dict to a mmdet detector builder
test_default_det_models_import: test that default_det_models can be imported and contains keys for human, face, hand, body, and wholebody
